spans.s: तिल m. 1. The sesamum plant, नासाभ्येति तिलप्रसूनपदवीम् Git.G.x.; 2. the seed of this plant, नाकस्माच्छांडिलीमाता विक्रीणाति तिलैस्तिलान् । अलुंचितां लुंचिताग्रैः Panch.ii.; 3. a mole, a spot; 4. a small particle as much as a sesamum seed.
तिल-अंबु, -उदक n. water with sesamum seed offered to the dead as an oblation, M.iii.223.
तिल-अंबु, -उदक n. water with sesamum seed offered to the dead as an oblation, M.iii.223.
तिल-उत्तमा f. name of an apsaras.
तिल-ओदन m.n. a dish of milk, rice and sesamum.
तिल-कल्क m. dough made of ground sesamum.
तिल-कल्क˚ज m. oil-cake made of the sediment of ground sesamum.
तिल-कालक m. a mole, a dark spot under the skin.
तिल-किट्ट न्।, -खलि, -खली ऋ।, -चूर्ण न्। n. the sediment of sesamum after the oil is pressed out.
तिल-खलि f. the sediment of sesamum after the oil is pressed out.
तिल-खली f. the sediment of sesamum after the oil is pressed out.
तिल-किट्ट न्।, -खलि, -खली ऋ।, -चूर्ण न्। n. the sediment of sesamum after the oil is pressed out.
तिल-तंडुलक n. an embrace (because in it, the two bodies are blended together like a mixture of sesamum and rice).
तिलंतुद m. an oilman.
तिल-तैल n. sesamum oil.
तिल-पर्ण (I) m. turpentine.
तिल-पर्ण (II) n. sandal wood.
तिल-पर्णी f. 1. the sandal tree; 2. frankincense; 3. turpentine.
तिल-रस m. sesamum oil.
तिल-शस् ind. in pieces as small as sesamum seeds.
तिल-स्नेह m. sesamum oil.
तिल-होम m. a burnt offering of sesamum.
तिल्व m. The lodhra tree.
तिलक (I) m. 1. A species of tree with beautiful flowers, न खलु शोभयति स्म वनस्थलीं न तिलकस्तिलकः प्रमदामिव R.ix.41; 2. a freckle or natural mark under the skin.

तिलक (II) m.n. 1. A mark of sandal wood &c. on the forehead as an ornament or sectarial distinction, मुखे मधुश्रीस्तिलकं प्रकाश्य K.S.iii.30, तिमिरोदितविधुमंडलनिर्मलमलयजतिलकनिवेशम् Git.G.xi.; 2. the best, the chief (generally at the end of compounds).
तिलक (III) n. 1. The bladder; 2. the lungs; 3. a kind of salt.
तिलका f. A kind of necklace.
तिलक-आश्रय m. the forehead.
तिलित्स m. A large snake.
